content.title: High Point University - The Nation's #1 Best Run College
content.text: Accelerated Career Outcomes The university you choose should create a path for your future. That’s why High Point University is committed to your long-term personal and professional success. 99% of HPU graduates are employed or in graduate school within 180 days – 14 points above the national average! To see what your future could look like, watch dozens of alumni share their HPU story of how they launched stellar careers. Undergraduate HPU offers 73 undergraduate majors and 70 minors. With academic innovation and experiential learning, you will receive an extraordinary education in an inspiring environment with caring people. Graduate Whether you’re seeking to advance in your current field or pivoting to a new career path, HPU’s online and in-person graduate programs equip you with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to reach your full potential. Admissions at HPU At HPU, our commitment to prepare students for a life of success and significance is rooted in a powerful combination of fast-paced innovation and strong values. Caring People | Caring Culture Concierge, At Your Service Fran, Campus Concierge Let's Talk Admissions at HPU Jonathan Whitfield How my Success Coach Helped Me Braeden (Class President 2023-24) HPU Named #1 by U.S. News and World Report High Point University continues to be recognized for its commitment to innovation and student success, earning three #1 rankings in U.S. News & World Report’s 2026 Best Colleges edition.
